evidence.model_retirement: Documented 'Model Retirement on May 15' migration guide for Grok models
evidence.no_version_pin: Cannot pin to specific model versions; aliases auto-upgrade
evidence.forced_migration: Model retirements force migration to newer versions (Grok 4.5 latest)
evidence.behavioral_changes: New models have different capabilities (agentic tool calling, reasoning, voice, image, video)
evidence.multi_modal_shift: Platform expanding from text-only to code, voice, image, video generation
evidence.pricing_changes: Pricing model changes with new capabilities (e.g., $2-6/1M tokens, $0.02/image, $0.05/sec video)
evidence.source: https://docs.x.ai/ (Migration Guides > Model Retirement on May 15)

impact.description: Content drift induced by model retirement schedule (May 15 deadline) with no version pinning. Forced migration to newer multi-modal models (Grok 4.5) with different capabilities, pricing, and behavioral characteristics. Platform shift from text-only to full multi-modal (code, voice, image, video) changes application architecture requirements. No opt-out from retirement timeline.

remediation.notes: Migration guide provided but no opt-out; must test and adapt to new model versions
